## Problem

Several suites leave \`parity-source-registry-*\` rows in \`ob_sources\` (approved/active) without cleanup. On main these sat inert because nothing produced from them. PR #609's maintenance sweep is a cross-namespace producer by design (\`selectSourcesNeedingDerivation\` with \`undefined\` writable namespaces), so those leftovers became real queued \`graph.derive\` jobs mid-suite and broke an unrelated test (\`026 maintenance queue\` concurrent-claim race: Expected 1, Received 2).

## What happened in #609

The lane worked around it in its OWN test (cleanup by \`job_kind\` across all namespaces, runtime stopped before delete) — proven by full-suite runs: main 3701/0, branch-before 3701/1, branch-after 3702/0. The owning suites' missing cleanup was out of that lane's scope and remains.

## Ask

Fix cleanup in the suites that create \`parity-source-registry-*\` fixtures so they tear down what they seed. The next global producer added to the codebase will hit the same rows.

## SME

Pattern captured in \`docs/sme/correctness.md\` → \`review.producer_activation_promotes_inert_fixtures\` (2026-08-07).
